Elena — thanks for the packet, looks good at first pass. Looping in Marissa from FinOps to finalize rails and PO mapping.

Quick answers and next steps:
- Preferred route: ACH for recurring invoices; we may use wire for one-off larger transfers (we'll request that separately). Please provide the ACH account + routing exactly as on your voided check — we'll kick off two micro-deposits to validate.
- PO placement: include the Redwood PO number on the invoice header line ("PO:") and also add a separate "Remit To:" block with your legal name. Example: "PO: 8792
Remit To: Skyward Technologies - 401 Market St, Suite 300". That format maps to our PO ingestion.
- Remittance / portal upload: CSV is fine; required headers are invoice_number, invoice_date, amount, po_number, remit_email. I attached our vendor CSV template — feel free to populate a sample and I will test the import.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_csv_template.csv

Action items:
1) Elena: confirm whether ACH is fine (reply with final account/routing) and provide remit contact email for remittance-only notices.
2) Marissa: will initiate micro-deposit once account info verified and send confirmation here.

Thanks — aim to have you in the system by COB Friday if we get the account details today.
